title: Super Mario Advance 4: Super Mario Bros. 3 - World-e Minigame 2
description:
A background used in one of the World-E minigames from Super Mario Advance 4: Super Mario Bros. 3 but now converted into Layer 3.

Note: It requires a sprite status bar or a patch in order to make it work like the RAM Toggled Status Bar (& IRQ) Patch as a example.
